versions.subject: Add files via upload
versions.detection:
description: Please add more file extentions and magic bytes to the logic of your choice. 
selection1:
  EventType:
    - FileCreate
    - FileRename
  EventID: 11
selection2:
  Image|endswith:
    - 'winword.exe'
    - 'excel.exe'
    - 'powerpnt.exe'
selection3:
  FileName|endswith:
  - ".exe"
  - ".dll"
  - ".ocx"
  - ".com"
  - ".ps1"
  - ".vbs"
  - ".sys"
  - ".bat"
  - ".scr"
  - ".proj"
selection4:
  FileMagicBytes|startswith:
  - "4D5A"
condition: selection1 AND selection2 AND (selection3 OR selection4)
versions.spl: EventType IN ("FileCreate", "FileRename") EventID=11 Image IN ("*winword.exe", "*excel.exe", "*powerpnt.exe") FileName IN ("*.exe", "*.dll", "*.ocx", "*.com", "*.ps1", "*.vbs", "*.sys", "*.bat", "*.scr", "*.proj") OR FileMagicBytes="4D5A*"
